description: The marketplace's PocketBase toolkit: an A2App adapter for PocketBase (it began as the Agent App Framework's, and is maintained here; see framework.lock.json) for apps built with the agent-app UI kit (React + Vite in frontend/), plus the compatibility hooks those apps' own code and UIs rely on, and agent sign-in (another person's agent, acting as that person). NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: hooks syntax + rules and agent sign-in self-tests
gate.run: node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_rules.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_impl.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app.pb.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_agents.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_agents.pb.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_system.pb.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_triggers.pb.js && node pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_rules.js --selftest && node pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_agents.js --selftest
